speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with ambiguous genitalia, virilization of the mother, and osteoporosis due to hypertension and low cortisol.
